verdict.rationale: Riveter offers multiple mechanisms that let a developer choose speed vs depth: quick_search returns synchronous snippet results immediately, while search_agent/enrichment runs a slower AI-research loop for more complete answers; SDKs support wait_for_result long-polling, polling, or webhook_url callbacks to control exactly when results are delivered, plus dry_run for cost/latency estimation before committing. However, there's no explicit documentation framing this as a deliberate 'latency vs completeness' dial, no partial/streaming result option, and no benchmarks showing the tradeoff quantitatively. missing for 10: explicit latency/completeness tradeoff framing, streaming/partial content delivery option, quantitative benchmarks comparing quick_search vs search_agent completeness.
